{'paragraph_index': 0, 'translation': "Apple is less than two weeks away from launching a brand-new smart display device, according to the latest report from Bloomberg. The report also revealed design details of Apple's long-awaited smart home hub."}

{'paragraph_index': 1, 'translation': 'According to Bloomberg, the home hub will feature a 6-inch square display. The overall design is reminiscent of the classic iMac G4 — which in its day had a hemispherical base paired with a metal support arm holding up the screen.'}

{'paragraph_index': 2, 'translation': 'According to Mark Gurman, the device is "roughly as thick as an iPhone," with quarter-inch-wide black bezels around the screen, similar to older iPads. The body features rounded corners, "with no sharp edges at all."'}

{'paragraph_index': 3, 'translation': 'Below are more design details from the report:'}

  • {'paragraph_index': 4, 'translation': 'The body features Apple\'s "standard gray aluminium finish," with a "rubber base to keep it steady on a desk."'}
  • {'paragraph_index': 5, 'translation': 'The device is powered via a USB-C port and has no built-in battery, so it must remain plugged in at all times.'}
  • {'paragraph_index': 6, 'translation': 'The display is mounted on a "circular metal base featuring a series of concentric perforations for the speaker."'}
  • {'paragraph_index': 7, 'translation': 'The display connects to the base via a "polished metal arm."'}
  • {'paragraph_index': 8, 'translation': 'Users can tilt the display forward or backward.'}
  • {'paragraph_index': 9, 'translation': 'There are no volume buttons or power buttons on the device.'}
  • {'paragraph_index': 10, 'translation': 'There is a single front-facing FaceTime camera, and no rear-facing camera.'}

{'paragraph_index': 11, 'translation': 'Bloomberg also noted that there is another version of the home hub "designed for wall mounting." This version is also powered via USB-C, and features a "slim square base below the display with speakers and microphones inside." The base is reportedly "flush against the wall, just below the screen."'}

{'paragraph_index': 12, 'translation': "For the full report, head over to Bloomberg. What do you think of Apple's home hub product? Are you planning to pick one up (or more than one)? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments."}
